artists.source_line: ᴡᴇʟᴄᴏᴍᴇ ʙᴀᴄᴋ ᴛᴏ ɪʟᴋꜱꜰ ʀɪɢᴀ ᴇᴅɪᴛɪᴏɴ. Together with our partners 𝐇𝐎𝐓 𝐈𝐂𝐄 𝐊𝐈𝐙 from Riga, we are super excited to organize this event for the fifth time in Latvia. After the last and successful edition, we can assure you that we will take you to the next level. This festival will be “All-in One Hotel”.

features.rationale: The festival is described as an All-in One Hotel, meaning the parties happen in the hotel where dancers stay.
The programme lists a Thursday preparty before the main event.
The expectations list three days of socials, which are daytime socials.
The expectations list three days of workshops as part of the event.
Masterclasses are listed among the event expectations.
A dance competition is listed among the event expectations.
The expectations list taxi and guest dancers being present.
